instruction: A clean studio photograph captured in a medium shot at eye-level. In a minimalist indoor studio with a plain off-white background, three women pose together. On the left, the Caucasian woman in a black blazer (R3) stands facing right, smiling as she raises her right hand. On the right, the East Asian woman in a white collarless shirt and black pants (R2) stands facing left, smiling as she raises her left hand to high-five the Caucasian woman (R3). In the center, the Black woman in a white button-up shirt and black skirt (R1) stands with her arms crossed, smiling directly at the camera. The scene is illuminated by bright, soft, even studio lighting.
